tagline: Istanbul's planned modern business and residential district on the Asian side — towers, tech companies, and a growing lifestyle scene.

items.name: Emaar Square Mall Cafés
items.description: The premium Emaar Square shopping complex has multiple specialty coffee shops and café chains. The most reliable coffee stop in the area.

items.name: Nef Levent Ofis Kafeler
items.description: The business district streets around Ataşehir have a growing number of specialty coffee shops catering to the tech and finance crowd.

items.name: Emaar Square Food Hall
items.description: A wide range of restaurants across all cuisines and price points inside the Emaar complex. Reliable for any group.

items.name: Ataşehir Bulvarı Restoranları
items.description: The main boulevard has a growing restaurant scene with everything from traditional Turkish to international options.

items.name: Emaar Square Mall
items.description: One of Istanbul's premium shopping destinations with international and Turkish brands, cinema, and a good selection of dining.

items.name: Viaport Marina
items.description: A lifestyle and marina complex nearby with restaurants and waterfront walks. Good for a weekend outing.

tips: Ataşehir is on the M4 metro line — well connected to Kadıköy and Sabiha Gökçen Airport.
Primarily a business and residential area — better for working meetings than tourism or exploration.
Most expats in Ataşehir are here for work with tech companies or finance firms. A practical, modern area.
For more character and social life, Kadıköy (one metro zone away) is a much better option.
